Package arcade.patch.agent.cell

Class PatchCellRandom

java.lang.Object
arcade.patch.agent.cell.PatchCell
arcade.patch.agent.cell.PatchCellRandom
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cell, Serializable, sim.engine.Steppable
public class PatchCellRandom extends PatchCell
Extension of PatchCell for cells with randomly assigned states.

These agents will simulate their metabolism and signaling processes, like PatchCellTissue, but cell states are randomly selected from all possible states, rather than following specific rules that guide
